title: UnDercontrol Board Resource
description: Schema for Kanban board YAML resource files. Boards organize tasks into columns with optional query filters and auto-actions.

board_type.description: private: shows all accessible tasks. shared: shows only tasks shared with the board's group.

columns.description: Ordered list of columns. Order in the array determines display order.

default_tags.description: Tags automatically applied to tasks created in this board.

project_id.description: Optional reference to a Project entity. When set, the project's cwd is used as a fallback if the board has no explicit projectDir in its metadata.

id.description: Column identifier (e.g. "col-todo"). Assigned by the server when omitted; include it on updates to keep column identity stable.

query.description: SQL-like filter query for tasks in this column (e.g., "status = 'todo'", "status = 'in-progress' AND tags CONTAINS 'urgent'"). On every create/update the server derives source=query actions from this query (e.g. "status = 'todo'" generates SET status on enter). Use dry_run=true (ud apply --dry-run) to preview the generated actions.

actions.description: Manual actions executed when a card enters or leaves this column, in addition to the auto-generated ones. Actions with source=query are derived server-side from the column query and should not be supplied.

field.description: Field to update: "status", "tags", or a custom field like "cf.priority".

value.description: Value to apply. Empty for clear operations.

operation.description: set/clear for scalar fields, add/remove for array fields.

trigger.description: When to execute: card enters or leaves the column.

source.description: query = auto-generated server-side from the column query (derived state, never supply); manual = user-defined.

example.description:
Example board YAML:

apiVersion: ud/v1
kind: Board
spec:
  name: Sprint Board
  board_type: private
  default_tags: [sprint-1]
  columns:
    - name: Backlog
      query: "status = 'todo'"
    - name: In Progress
      query: "status = 'in-progress'"
    - name: Review
      query: "status = 'pending'"
    - name: Done
      query: "status = 'done'"
